weaknesses.name: signals_still_overlap
weaknesses.detail: answerable floor 0.49 vs unanswerable ceiling 10.68; the classes overlap, which is why the gate defers most decisions

weaknesses.name: value_absent_questions_still_score_high
weaknesses.detail: 'how long is the observation period between regions' scores 8.85 on retrieval alone; only the value-demand check keeps it out of the sufficient band

weaknesses.name: chunk_selection_is_weak
weaknesses.detail: the gold chunk is ranked first for 54% of 80 questions; a citation points at a chunk, so this bounds citation precision

rows.description: Refusal gate marked 150/265 unanswerable questions answerable — a 56.6% false-answer rate reported at the Sprint 2 gate as zero
rows.rootCause: Test set too small and too easy, written by the implementer

rows.description: Evidence gate answered a value-demanding question the corpus never answers, scoring 8.85
rows.rootCause: Similarity signals cannot distinguish "about this subject" from "answers this question"

rows.description: Re-ranker experiment returned a null result that was two bugs: a NaN checkpoint and a saturated metric
rows.rootCause: NaN sorts as a no-op; document-level MRR was already 0.986

rows.description: Seed loader destroyed one embedding model's vectors when reloading under another
Retry loop re-sent an identical prompt, so it could never succeed
rows.rootCause: Design oversight: the edge existed, the feedback did not

rows.description: Semantic cache served the previous answer to a correction retry (0.886 similarity vs 0.60 threshold)
rows.rootCause: Emergent interaction between two individually correct, individually measured components

rows.description: `RUN_BUDGET_USD=0` killed every run mid-stream with an unhandled error
CSP blocked React hydration in development; every button was inert HTML
rows.rootCause: A policy correct for production made development impossible

rows.description: The console displayed assessments the governance layer had refused to emit
Spend reservation priced against `providers[0]`, under-reserving 4x when failover reached a costlier provider
rows.rootCause: The guard assumed the cheapest candidate would serve

rows.description: A comment inside a backslash continuation truncated the Semgrep invocation; the scan ran without its exclusion, printed success, and the shell exited 127 on the orphaned flag
rows.rootCause: Shell semantics: a comment ends a continuation. Every visible signal pointed elsewhere

rows.description: No body-size limit on the run endpoint; a 200KB body reached the agent and returned 502 instead of being refused
rows.rootCause: Cost bounds were applied to spend and rate, but not to input length

rows.description: The rate-limit pen test could not fail: it sent 8 requests against a limit of 20, and its pass condition accepted `all(c >= 400)`, so a service that was DOWN reported as correctly rate limited
rows.rootCause: A test written to pass rather than to detect

rows.description: Traceability statuses drifted in both directions: 4 rows used statuses the legend never defined (`Done (design)`/`(gate)`/`(decision)`) which the delivery page counted as done, and 1 row sat at `Planned` while its test had passed for four sprints
rows.rootCause: A status column maintained by hand, rendered publicly as fact

rows.description: The first README checker could not fail: it searched for each figure as a substring of the whole file, so changing `Commits \
rows.rootCause: 54` to 99 still passed because "54" appears in "54% of questions"

rows.description: Sprints 6 and 7 were worked and shipped with no planning ceremony and no plan document; the sprint numbers existed only in defect-log entries, and a Sprint 5 retrospective commitment to raise exactly this was never honoured
rows.rootCause: Governance applied to the product but not to the process; the control relied on someone remembering

rows.description: ADR-0003 placed the agent runtime on Hugging Face Docker Spaces "because it is free"; Docker Spaces are PRO-only, so three sprints of deployment work targeted a platform that cannot host it at $0
rows.rootCause: A pricing claim recorded in an ADR without ever being read from the pricing page

rows.description: CI never built the web application. A Dependabot PR taking Next 15→16 reported 10/10 green while the production build failed on all seven pages; no job had ever run `next build`
rows.rootCause: A pipeline whose green tick exercises none of the code under change
